rules.title: Use the official SDK
rules.text: Use the official Anthropic SDK and read the API key from the environment.

rules.title: Check current model ids
rules.text: Look up current model identifiers in the official documentation instead of guessing them, and keep them in configuration.

rules.title: Prompt caching
rules.text: Put stable content first and use prompt caching for large repeated prefixes.

rules.title: Tool use loops
rules.text: Validate tool inputs, return clear tool errors to the model and cap the number of loop iterations.

rules.title: Handle stop reasons
rules.text: Check stop_reason and handle max_tokens truncation and tool_use turns explicitly.

rules.title: System prompt for role and rules
rules.text: Put role, rules and output format in the system prompt and task data in user messages.
